title: sarothamnus lusitanicus
intro: Sarothamnus lusitanicus, commonly known as Spanish broom, is a flowering legume native to the Iberian Peninsula. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal problems. The health benefits of Spanish broom include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Sarothamnus lusitanicus include isoflavones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
